parole.testo: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese universidade, possibly borrowed from Old Spanish universidat, a learned borrowing from Medieval Latin ūniversitās, from Latin ūniversus + -tas.

parole.significato: villancico (traditional Spanish or Portuguese folk song)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Old Spanish villancete, from villano (“peasant”), from Medieval Latin vīllānus (“villager”), whence also Portuguese vilão.
